_help: Which business type each build is for. RETAIL, RESTAURANT or both. A build that is not listed here is shown to everyone. Newest first.

releases.note: Shop PC and cloud never work on the same bill: a shop PC bill is charged/changed only on the shop PC, a cloud bill only on cloud. Safety net for older bills: a second payment arriving by sync is kept out of sales/till and listed in Sync conflicts (and Audit log); an item added after the other side closed the bill goes to a new held bill on the same table. Sync now on the shop PC wakes the background sync and returns at once (counters do not wait).

Database clock follows app time (night sales on the right day on cloud); sale point stays fast after years of data: 4 speed indexes (added in background on update), faster dashboard, closing history and kitchen print status

Login lock (5 wrong = 10 min), account close and bill charge in one queue (money only into own open account), kitchen slips actually printed (shop PC direct to printer IP, else counter) with failed badge, app/QR order limits, user details only for Users permission, build-info counts only for super admin

Sale point: permission on every save, kitchen-sent void approved and logged by the server, cancelled/printed bills recorded, one manager-password lock everywhere, void after close owner-only and shown in closing history, bill number safe after 300+ bills, secrets hidden, tablet waiter can save orders, cash clear needs manager

Sale point hardening: item price/name from menu, no negative charges, tax rate from Settings, discount approval by %, customer discount only by manager, manager password lock after 5 wrong tries, own shift only, every server reprint of a charged bill marked DUPLICATE COPY, yesterday held bill charged today moves to today, QR whole quantities
Bill number always from server (first bill after midnight is #0001); cashier discount limit (default 10%) with manager password above it; Duplicate reprint marked DUPLICATE COPY and logged

One table one bill; any counter opens a table bill and the closer gets the amount; reducing a kitchen-sent qty needs manager password and prints a cancel slip; bill cancelled after KOT prints a cancel slip

Sale point: QR order goes to its own table bill, account cannot close with open bills, deleted menu item does not block a held bill, tablet keeps discount/service/tax and cannot overwrite newer items, cashier gets no sale figures
Kitchen: item removed after KOT shows CANCELLED and a cancel slip prints; handed-over bill cannot be charged from the old screen; discount never more than the bill

Reports: expenses in Shift closing and Account wise, Online / Wallet column, refunds only for paid bills, void reason and user, item counts; dashboard running orders; tables show Occupied when a bill is open

Restaurant POS rush safety: no double sale on retry, closed bill cannot be charged again, a bill changed on another counter or tablet reopens fresh, no failed or half-saved bills in rush, unsaved bill comes back after reload, tablet adds to the table's existing bill
Restaurant POS: an item removed from a bill stays removed after hold, KOT, print and resume; it is not charged or counted in item reports
Restaurant POS: bills never merge into another order, Duplicate list complete and fresh, table opens its held bill. New login page; any business user can log in from any browser
Owner mobile app: Yesterday button — full sale of yesterday
Retail: receipt prints on bill close, held bills per counter, duplicate bill by date, faster bill search, safe bill numbers on many counters, offline database auto-repair
Retail: Excel import, fast product screens on large catalogs, POS name search on Enter
